definition.kind: analytical teaching construction, not observed experimental data
definition.reader_question: Continuity preserves nearby outputs, a jump breaks this property, and continuity does not guarantee a common two-sided slope.
definition.chapter_source: 03-mathematical-analysis.tex: 度量空间与收敛、连续性与Lipschitz条件、一元导数与局部变化率
definition.formula: f1(x)=x^2: at x0=0, epsilon=1/4 and delta=1/2 imply |x|<delta -> |f1(x)|<epsilon. j(x)=0 for x<0, 1 for x>=0. f3(x)=|x|: continuous at 0; left/right derivatives=-1/+1.
definition.processing: Direct evaluation; no smoothing or random sampling. Discontinuous pieces are drawn separately.
